<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the base peak at m/z 127.0997 corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈126.092 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈8 % M+1) suggests about 8 carbons. The formula C₈H₁₄O has a calculated monoisotopic mass of 126.104 Da, which is the closest match to the observed mass and fits the isotopic distribution. Therefore, the molecular formula is C8H14O.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H14O</final_answer>
